title: Decision Regarding Plant Variety No. 0438/MOIC, Dated 30 March 2023
text:
The Ministry of Industry and Commerce issued Decision Regarding Plant Variety No. 0438/MOIC, dated 30 March 2023 to establish principles and regulations governing new plant varieties, including registration, post-registration procedures, representation, administrative inspection, and management. The decision aims to ensure the consistent enforcement of intellectual property laws nationwide and to support the country’s socio-economic development.
